US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Petroleum wax is a refined mixture of solid hydrocarbons, including paraffin and microcrystalline preparations. FDA specifies purity and physical-property requirements for the food-use material. Listed functions include processing lubrication, release, protective coating and some chewing-gum-base uses. This broad historical entry covers more than one wax grade, so one grade's intake assessment does not automatically describe all waxes.
